operations.description: Lists all public, remixable assets. These are assets with an access level of PUBLIC and published under the CC-By license.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] poly assets list [PATH] assets [PARAMS] access alt by callback category complexity curated fields format key keywords max oauth order page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] assets file format info list params presentation remix response

operations.description: Returns detailed information about an asset given its name. PRIVATE assets are returned only if the currently authenticated user (via OAuth token) is the author of the asset.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] poly assets [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] complexity file format info params presentation quaternion remix

operations.description: Lists assets authored by the given user. Only the value 'me', representing the currently-authenticated user, is supported. May include assets with an access level of PRIVATE or UNLISTED and assets which are All Rights Reserved for the currently-authenticated user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] poly users assets list [PATH] assets [PARAMS] access alt by callback fields format key name oauth order page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user visibility xgafv [SCHEMA] asset assets list response user

operations.description: Lists assets that the user has liked. Only the value 'me', representing the currently-authenticated user, is supported. May include assets with an access level of UNLISTED.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] poly users likedassets list [PATH] likedassets [PARAMS] access alt by callback fields format key name oauth order page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] assets file format info liked list params presentation remix response
